### CVE-2024-0553 — Gnutls: incomplete fix for cve-2023-5981
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2024-01-16 | Updated: 2026-11-05 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-203 Observable Discrepancy
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A vulnerability was found in GnuTLS. The response times to malformed ciphertexts in RSA-PSK ClientKeyExchange differ from the response times of ciphertexts with correct PKCS#1 v1.5 padding. This issue may allow a remote attacker to perform a timing side-channel attack in the RSA-PSK key exchange, potentially leading to the leakage of sensitive data. CVE-2024-0553 is designated as an incomplete resolution for CVE-2023-5981.

**workarounds:** Mitigation for this issue is either not available or the currently available options don't meet the Red Hat Product Security criteria comprising ease of use and deployment, applicability to widespread installation base or stability.

### CVE-2024-0567 — Gnutls: rejects certificate chain with distributed trust
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2024-01-16 | Updated: 2026-11-24 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-347 Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- CVSS 3.1 (nvd:secalert@redhat.com:Secondary): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- CVSS 3.1 (nvd:nvd@nist.gov:Primary): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`

A vulnerability was found in GnuTLS, where a cockpit (which uses gnuTLS) rejects a certificate chain with distributed trust. This issue occurs when validating a certificate chain with cockpit-certificate-ensure. This flaw allows an unauthenticated, remote client or attacker to initiate a denial of service attack.

**workarounds:** Mitigation for this issue is either not available or the currently available options don't meet the Red Hat Product Security criteria comprising ease of use and deployment, applicability to widespread installation base or stability.

Affected:
-  / gnutls: affected 3.8.0 <3.8.3 (semver)

### CVE-2024-0901 — SEGV and out of bounds memory read from malicious packet
- Assigner: wolfSSL | Published: 2024-03-25 | Updated: 2024-08-01 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-129 CWE-129 Improper Validation of Array Index
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:L/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Remotely executed SEGV and out of bounds read allows malicious packet sender to crash or cause an out of bounds read via sending a malformed packet with the correct length.


**solutions:** Update wolfSSL to 5.7.0 or apply the fix located in:  https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/pull/7099 .


Affected:
- wolfSSL / wolfSSL: affected 3.12.2 <=5.6.6 (release bundle)
- wolfssl / wolfssl: affected 3.12.2 <=5.6.6 (custom)

Credits: Jiamin Yu

References:
- https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/issues/7089
- https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/pull/7099

### CVE-2024-5991 — Buffer overread in domain name matching
- Assigner: wolfSSL | Published: 2024-08-27 | Updated: 2024-08-27 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-125 CWE-125 Out-of-bounds Read
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

In function MatchDomainName(), input param str is treated as a NULL terminated string despite being user provided and unchecked. Specifically, the function X509_check_host() takes in a pointer and length to check against, with no requirements that it be NULL terminated. If a caller was attempting to do a name check on a non-NULL terminated buffer, the code would read beyond the bounds of the input array until it found a NULL terminator.This issue affects wolfSSL: through 5.7.0.

**solutions:** Fixed in the following github pull request  https://https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/pull/7604

Affected:
- wolfSSL / wolfSSL: affected 0 <=5.7.0 (release bundle)
- wolfssl / wolfssl: affected 0 <=5.7.0 (custom)

References:
- https://https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/pull/7604

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

An issue was discovered in the Bouncy Castle Crypto Package For Java before BC TLS Java 1.0.19 (ships with BC Java 1.78, BC Java (LTS) 2.73.6) and before BC FIPS TLS Java 1.0.19. When endpoint identification is enabled in the BCJSSE and an SSL socket is created without an explicit hostname (as happens with HttpsURLConnection), hostname verification could be performed against a DNS-resolved IP address in some situations, opening up a possibility of DNS poisoning.

### CVE-2024-45158
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2024-09-05 | Updated: 2024-11-25 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-121 CWE-121 Stack-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

An issue was discovered in Mbed TLS 3.6 before 3.6.1. A stack buffer overflow in mbedtls_ecdsa_der_to_raw() and mbedtls_ecdsa_raw_to_der() can occur when the bits parameter is larger than the largest supported curve. In some configurations with PSA disabled, all values of bits are affected. (This never happens in internal library calls, but can affect applications that call these functions directly.)

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
- mbed / mbedtls: affected 3.6 <3.6.1 (custom)

References:
- https://mbed-tls.readthedocs.io/en/latest/security-advisories/
